card.name: Linking words in ADHD drug trial text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, or, with, for, and) and sometimes a number or space, in stimulant and ADHD drug label text. They fall between a drug or patient group and placebo, comparison arms, or dose figures.

modes.label: Comparison with placebo
modes.description: A linking word between a drug group and the placebo group in trial results.
modes.example: 21/1,308 (1.6%) of atomoxetine patients versus 9/806 (1.1%)<< of>> placebo-treated patients spontaneously reported treatment emergent

modes.label: Dose figures
modes.description: A space or the first digit of a number in maximum-dose or dose-range statements.

modes.label: Linking word before a drug name
modes.description: A word like with or or joining a patient group to a stimulant drug name.
modes.example: Prior to treating patients<< with>> lisdexamfetamine dimes

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words and numbers in ADHD drug label text where a drug is compared with placebo or a dose is given.
